evidence.claim: Ranpak’s relevance to restaurant off-premise packaging is plausible but unproven; the evidence supports paper-based protective packaging and cold-chain exposure, not confirmed material restaurant or QSR exposure.

memory_update.text: KRT is the strongest underfollowed small-cap public candidate for restaurant off-premise packaging because its filings directly tie products to national/regional restaurants and foodservice settings.

GPK should remain a reference anchor rather than the primary alpha hunt: public filings confirm QSR cups/lids/containers and major QSR customers, but the company is broader and better-followed than the desired discovery lane.
BZLFY is a distribution-gate candidate via US OTC ADR; exposure to packaging/disposables is clear, but material restaurant/QSR mix must be verified before promotion beyond Layer 1B.

PACK is only a speculative shadow candidate for restaurant packaging; include for cold-chain/e-commerce consumables optionality, but falsify quickly if no food delivery, grocery, meal-kit or restaurant-distribution revenue evidence appears.

Important private context anchors for this node include Dart Container, Novolex/Pactiv Evergreen, Imperial Dade, National DCP and broadline distributors such as Sysco/US Foods/PFG; they help map customer and distribution dependencies but are not primary public candidates in this pass.

The likely chokepoint is not generic packaging capacity alone; it is the combination of food-contact compliance, sustainable-material rules, custom branding, leakage/temperature performance, and distributor access to multi-unit restaurant systems.

node: Off-premise packaging, disposables, and delivery-enabling consumables
summary: Layer 1B expands the restaurant off-premise packaging node into a two-lane universe. Reference lane: Graphic Packaging as a scaled public context anchor for QSR cups, lids and food containers. Underfollowed lane: Karat Packaging as the clearest small-cap direct foodservice disposable packaging exposure; Bunzl ADR as a less obvious non-food/disposables distribution gate; Ranpak as a second-order, weaker-evidence paper-based packaging and cold-chain/e-commerce consumables hypothesis. Pactiv Evergreen/Dart/Novolex/Imperial Dade appear important privately held context anchors but are excluded from candidates because the goal is US-listed public assets.
